title: French-Style Grilled Chicken à la Brasa
description: A Peruvian-inspired twist on traditional French grilled chicken, marinated in zesty flavors and grilled to perfection.
instructions: In a blender or food processor, combine marinade ingredients and blend until smooth.
Place chicken legs in a large zip-top plastic bag or a shallow dish. Pour marinade over chicken and massage to coat.
Refrigerate for at least 2 hours or overnight.
Remove chicken from marinade, letting any excess liquid drip off.
Brush chicken with avocado oil and season with salt, pepper, and garlic powder (if using).
Grill chicken for 5-7 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
Let chicken rest for 5 minutes before serving.
Serve hot with grilled lemon wedges and fresh rosemary sprigs on top.
